sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers Salaries Allowances and Privileges Amendment Act 1992
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ACT II OF 1992
ACT II OF 1992
BALOCHISTAN CHIEF
MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS
(SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1992
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Chief Minister and
Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (III of
1975).
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th April, 1992]
No. PAB/LEGIS:III(4)/91, dated
30-4-1992.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 10th March, 1992 and assented to
by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly:--
1. Short title and
commencement.------(1) This Act may be called the Balochistan Chief
Minister and Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges)
(Amendment) Act, 1992.
(2) It shall come into force at
once and shall be deemed to have taken effect from the 17th day of November,
1990.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 8 of Act III of 1975

ACT II OF 1992
ACT II OF 1992
BALOCHISTAN CHIEF
MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS
(SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1992
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Chief Minister and
Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (III of
1975).
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th April, 1992]
No. PAB/LEGIS:III(4)/91, dated
30-4-1992.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 10th March, 1992 and assented to
by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly:--
2. Amendment of section 8 of
Act III of 1975:-----In the Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial
Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975, hereinafter referred
to as the said Act, in, subsection (6) of section 8, for the words "seven
thousand rupees" the words "fifteen thousand rupees" shall be
substituted.

sections.description:
Insertion of new section 8-A in Act III of 1975

ACT II OF 1992
ACT II OF 1992
BALOCHISTAN CHIEF
MINISTER AND PROVINCIAL MINISTERS
(SALARIES,
ALLOWANCES AND PRIVILEGES)
(AMENDMENT) ACT,
1992
An Act further to amend the Balochistan Chief Minister and
Provincial Ministers (Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) Act, 1975 (III of
1975).
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary, 30th April, 1992]
No. PAB/LEGIS:III(4)/91, dated
30-4-1992.--The Balochistan Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers
(Salaries, Allowances and Privileges) (Amendment) Bill, 1991 having been passed
by the Provincial Assembly of Balochistan on 10th March, 1992 and assented to
by the Governor of Balochistan, is hereby published as an Act of the Provincial
Assembly:--
3. Insertion of new section
8-A in Act III of 1975:--In the said Act, after section 8, the following
new section shall be inserted, namely:--
"8-A.
Hiring Ceiling.-A fixed sum of rupees twenty thousand per month in lump sum
shall be paid to the Chief Minister and Provincial Ministers if they choose to
reside in a hired house."
